data.name: Sanjidhi
data.long_meaning: Sanjidhi is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Goddess of Prosperity'. This beautiful name is derived from the words 'san' meaning 'all' and 'jidhi' meaning 'wishes'. It is believed that the name Sanjidhi bestows upon the child all the wishes and desires they may have, leading to a life filled with joy, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sanjidhi is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that invoking the name of the Goddess of Prosperity will bring abundance, wealth, and happiness into one's life. The name is often chanted during rituals and puja (worship) to seek her blessings for success, good health, and prosperity.
